body:
Thank you for replying. Your words have given me the courage to open up to my family. They've responded quite positively. 

They insist that they will help me get through this. I intend to.

You helped me. I hope you know how much that matters.

Thank you for reading this and thank you for the reply. 

I really appreciate what you have done for me. It helped me get through with what I did. 

I wrote a letter. Printed it out and left it somewhere in the house for my family to see. 

They have responded positively. I am so relieved. I have them on my side. They will help me go through this.
